description.value: Salt Spring Vineyards is a craft winery and wine retail shop situated at 151 Lee Road on Salt Spring Island, BC. As one of the Gulf Islands' estate wineries, it draws visitors seeking locally produced wines in a rural island setting. Touring cyclists completing Salt Spring Island's wine route may find it a natural stop along a scenic ride.
